user_query: I'm a food blogger and I'm looking for unique and interesting ingredients to feature in my recipes. Can you provide me with a list of all the available ingredients along with their nutritional information? Also, suggest a recipe that showcases one of these ingredients. Additionally, generate a QR code with the message 'Check out my latest recipe!' to share with my followers.

TaskList.description: 查询所有可用的食材及其营养信息
根据食材推荐一道特色菜谱
生成包含特定消息的二维码以便分享
